consumer: The GUI tile renderer asking 'should this remembered tile be drawn dimmed (out of current sight) rather than fully lit?', reading the player-visibility result for each nearby tile
scope: per-tile over the map region around the avatar within the export radius (not inventory)
decisive_source: src/arcopolis_export.cpp::write_tiles (seen) writes json 'seen' from ctx.m.pl_sees(p, ctx.radius), the player-facing visible-now proxy that distinguishes currently-seen from remembered tiles and may lag raw LOS
divergence: A tile the avatar explored earlier and remembers, now behind a just-closed door / out of LOS: raw state still holds its terrain and map::sees reachability is blocked, but the display must shade it dimmed (remembered) — a wrong authority using map::sees or omitting seen would render it as lit or blank instead of dimmed
